VS Code hands out forward-slash drive paths in several APIs. Both separators collapse to the same dash, so this slugs identically to windows-drive-lower.
Trailing separators are stripped before encoding, so a path and the same path with a trailing slash do not produce two slugs.
Degenerate: the trailing separator goes first, leaving the colon to become the single dash.

A UNC path has no colon; the two leading separators become two leading dashes.
